established_by_sources: Yetter proves arbitrary representative independence on the triangulated state-sum route.
Yetter's surgery route does not establish the arbitrary-H2 marked Kirby formula currently under audit.
Tham's index-three skein map is a vacuum projection; under the repository's upside-down convention it belongs to primal dotted one-handles.
Primal three-handles are Tham index-one handles and contribute inverse-dimension normalization rather than the index-three vacuum projection.
Tham proves handle-decomposition independence for the unmarked premodular skein construction.
scope_findings.inference_under_audit: A generalized marked surgery evaluator must use the dual handle complex. Primal 2-3 cancellation is enforced by the dual cycle kernel, while primal dotted 1-handles must implement the Tham index-three vacuum projection for dual d3-boundaries.
not_established_by_sources: Tham does not state the arbitrary-H2 homologically twisted surgery evaluator proposed in this repository.

Neither source by itself proves the repository's generalized integral-H2 representative descent; the missing integration is the dual-chain boundary movie together with the primal dotted-component vacuum calculation.
